postings.conferenceText: Call for Papers: Agents, Accountability & Action: Governing the Next Era of IntelligenceThe fusion of Data Science and emerging technologies continues to reshape business operations, the workforce, and the broader landscape of economic and societal progress. As we transition from the initial wave of agentic systems into widespread deployment, the demand for sophisticated data science skills and the innovative application of enabling technologies like cloud computing, Blockchain, big data analytics, IoT, and 6G networks remains paramount for driving digital transformation towards a human-centric, reliable, and sustainable future.This year, --DaSET 2026-- focuses on the critical nexus of --Agents, Accountability & Action: Governing the Next Era of Intelligence--. As Artificial Intelligence (AI) and frontier technologies evolve into highly autonomous agents capable of independent decision-making, the conversations must shift from what these technologies -can- do, to how they are -governed, monitored, and held accountable-. This conference aims to attract leading industry and academic researchers actively exploring the theoretical underpinnings, data architectures, and practical applications of data science required to build trustworthy, actionable, and responsible intelligent systems.--DaSET 2026-- invites paper submissions that address cutting-edge topics related to Data Science and Emerging Technologies, with a particular emphasis on the frameworks, methodologies, and applications of autonomous intelligence under responsible governance. We aim to provide a vibrant platform for experts and researchers to discuss the latest advancements, mitigate risks, and chart new directions for future research aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals for sustainable economic, social, and environmental progress.Authors are invited to contribute to the conference by submitting articles in the following (or any other relevant) areas:- Foundational Data Science- Machine Learning and AI Architecture- Data Science Applications- Emerging Trends in Data Science- Big Data Technologies & Advanced Data Pipelines- Data Mining & Visualization- Optimization Algorithms- Statistical Learning- Granular Computing and Fuzzy Systems- Computer Vision & Natural Language Processing- Foundations of Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems- Data-Driven Autonomous Systems & Decision Engines- Machine Learning for Autonomous Agents- Applications of Autonomous Intelligence in Industry- Human-Agent Interaction & Collaborative Intelligence- Frameworks for Algorithmic Accountability and Auditability- Trust, Security, and Ethics in Autonomous Systems- Explainable and Interpretable Autonomous Intelligence (XAI)- Bias Mitigation, Fairness, and Data Sovereignty- Legal, Regulatory, and Policy Implications of Autonomous Action- The Impact of Autonomous Action on Society and the Workforce- Edge AI and Distributed Autonomous Systems- Blockchain Technology & Decentralized Governance- Cybersecurity & Cryptography- Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4.0, and Envisioning Industry 5.0- Digital Health and Biomedical Informatics- Green AI, Sustainable Computing, and Environmental Informatics

postings.conferenceText: Rome and Online, from June 24-26, 2027 - the 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders hosts the international neurology community for three days of scholarly programme. postings.conferenceText: Topics: smart health personalized healthcare health informatics healthcare digital twinsCall for One-Page AbstractsThe 2026 International Workshop on Digital Twins for Chronic Disease Monitoring and Personalized Healthcare will be held in conjunction with the IEEE EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026) on December 12, 2026, in Hong Kong.The workshop will explore healthcare digital twins for continuous monitoring, early detection, and personalized management of chronic diseases. We invite one-page abstracts presenting research, emerging ideas, case studies, prototypes, or work in progress related to healthcare digital twins and personalized healthcare.Topics of interest include:• Multimodal health data integration• Wearable, mobile, and physiological sensing• Smartphone-based health monitoring• Mechanistic and physiology-based models• Machine learning and data-driven predictive models• Hybrid mechanistic and AI-based models• Disease progression detection and prediction• AI-assisted disease assessment and clinical decision support• Personalized disease management• Clinical integration of healthcare digital twins• Healthcare accessibility and continuity of careSubmission GuidelinesAbstracts should be limited to one page, written in English, and submitted in PDF format. The abstract should clearly describe the motivation, proposed approach or study, key findings or expected contribution, and relevance to the workshop. Submissions should include the title, author names, affiliations, and contact information for the corresponding author.Selected abstracts will be invited for oral presentation at the workshop.Important DatesAbstract submission deadline: October 1, 2026Acceptance notification: October 15, 2026Workshop date: December 12, 2026Workshop webpage:https://mdclab.info/hdt-bhi2026.php

postings.conferenceName: 2027 International Conference on System Safety and Security
postings.conferenceText: Topics: cybersecurity security training system safety engineering industrial practicesWe would like to invite you to participate in 2027 International Conference on System Safety and Security (ICSSS), which will be held at Georgia Southern University, Savannah, GA, USA from November 3-5, 2027.In the era of rapid advancements in information technology, artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things, ensuring system safety and security has become a critical global priority. As modern systems, including industrial control, aerospace, and healthcare, become increasingly intelligent, they also face a growing array of security threats. The Rise of Autonomous and Learning Systems: The integration of AI and Machine Learning (ML) introduces a new paradigm where 'safety' is no longer just about avoiding failure, but ensuring Algorithmic Responsibility and robustness against adversarial manipulation. ICSSS recognizes that for these technologies to be trusted in critical infrastructure, they must be designed with transparency, fairness, and ethical oversight at their core. The Human and Educational Foundation: Beyond technical innovation, the sustainability of system safety depends on a skilled workforce. By integrating Security Pedagogy and Education into its core mission, ICSSS seeks to bridge the gap between academic research and the classroom. We aim to explore how modern instruction, from ethical hacking labs to AI-driven curriculum, can prepare the next generation of engineers and scholars to tackle evolving global risks.Submission Guidelines1. Papers should be written in English and limited to 4-10 pages.2. The authors of the paper will take responsibility for any Intellectual Property issues concerning the papers on their own.3. Accepted full papers will be invited for oral presentation at the conference and will be published in the conference proceedings.4. Papers accepted to be published into the conference proceedings must fully comply with the conference format for the final camera ready submission.5. Accepted abstracts will be invited for oral presentation at the conference, the presentation WILL NOT be published.List of TopicsDesign and analysis of safety‑critical systemsHazard identification, risk assessment, and safety analysisReliability, Maintainability, and Availability (RAM) analysisSafety certification, standards, and regulatory complianceResilient system architecturesRisk management frameworks and resilience engineeringEmergency response, disaster recovery, and business continuityHuman factors, safety culture, and organizational resilienceNetwork, system, and cloud securitySecurity protocols, cryptography, and identity managementThreat modeling, vulnerability assessment, and intrusion detectionSecurity of IoT, Cyber‑Physical Systems (CPS), and SCADA systemsIndustrial control systems and smart manufacturing securityEmbedded system safety and securityCritical infrastructure protection and operational technology (OT) security...PublicationSubmitted paper will be peer reviewed by conference committees, and accepted papers will be included in ICSSS 2027 Conference Proceedings.VenueGeorgia Southern University (Armstrong Campus Student Union)Address: 11935 Abercorn Street, Savannah, GA 31419ContactMail Address: icsss_conf@acamedic.netPhone Number：+001(559)-8624927
